articles.title: China conducts second day of military drills around Taiwan
articles.summary: China has launched extensive live-fire military exercises targeting maritime areas north and southwest of Taiwan. These large-scale drills involve destroyers, frigates, fighters, and bombers, showcasing Beijing's military might and assertiveness in the region. The maneuvers significantly escalate cross-strait tensions, highlighting a critical geopolitical situation with potential implications for regional stability, demanding close international observation.

articles.title: Great white sharks face extinction in Mediterranean, say researchers
articles.summary: Great white sharks in the Mediterranean Sea are critically endangered and face imminent disappearance. Their populations are rapidly declining, primarily due to widespread illegal fishing. This crisis, highlighted by science teams, necessitates urgent conservation efforts and stricter enforcement against harmful practices to protect these apex predators and maintain the delicate marine ecosystem's balance.
